column2:
mainstream(n.)主流
(無詞性變化)
mainstream media 主流媒體
mainstream culture 主流文化
Online shopping has become part of the mainstream in recent years.
(近年來網路購物已經成為主流的一部分。)
Many young people get their news from social media instead of mainstream media.
(許多年輕人從社群媒體而非主流媒體獲得新聞。)

maintenance(n.)維修、保養、維持
maintain(v.)維持、保養
regular maintenance 定期保養
maintenance cost 維修費用
The elevator is closed for maintenance this afternoon.
(電梯今天下午因維修暫停使用。)
Regular maintenance can make your car last much longer.
(定期保養能讓你的車子用得更久。)

mammal(n.)哺乳動物
mammalian(adj.)哺乳動物的
marine mammal 海洋哺乳動物
large mammal 大型哺乳動物
Whales and dolphins are mammals, not fish.
(鯨魚和海豚是哺乳動物，不是魚類。)
Bats are the only mammals that can truly fly.
(蝙蝠是唯一真正會飛的哺乳動物。)

mandate(n.)授權、命令、任期
mandatory(adj.)強制的、義務的
a mandate to 做……的授權
government mandate 政府命令
The new government has a clear mandate to reform education.
(新政府獲得明確授權進行教育改革。)
The mask mandate was lifted after the pandemic eased.
(疫情趨緩後，口罩令便解除了。)

manifest(v./adj.)顯示、表明、明顯的
manifestation(n.)表現、顯示
manifest itself 顯現出來
manifest interest 表露興趣
The symptoms of the disease may not manifest for several years.
(這種疾病的症狀可能好幾年都不會顯現。)
Her talent for music manifested itself at an early age.
(她的音樂天分很早就顯露出來了。)

manipulate(v.)操縱、控制、巧妙處理
manipulation(n.)操縱
manipulative(adj.)善於操縱他人的
manipulate data 竄改資料
manipulate public opinion 操縱輿論
Some advertisements try to manipulate people's emotions.
(有些廣告試圖操縱人們的情緒。)
The scientist was accused of manipulating the results of the experiment.
(那位科學家被指控竄改實驗結果。)

mansion(n.)大廈、豪宅、宅邸
(無詞性變化)
luxury mansion 豪華宅邸
old mansion 古宅
The movie star lives in a huge mansion with a swimming pool.
(那位電影明星住在一棟有游泳池的豪宅裡。)
The old mansion has been turned into a museum.
(那座古宅已被改建成博物館。)

marine(adj./n.)海洋的、海軍陸戰隊員
(無詞性變化)
marine life 海洋生物
marine biologist 海洋生物學家
Plastic pollution is a serious threat to marine life.
(塑膠汙染對海洋生物是嚴重的威脅。)
She hopes to become a marine biologist and study coral reefs.
(她希望成為海洋生物學家並研究珊瑚礁。)

masculine(adj./n.)男性的、有男子氣概的、陽性(詞)
masculinity(n.)男子氣概
masculine image 男性化形象
masculine voice 低沉的男性嗓音
He has a deep, masculine voice.
(他有低沉、富男子氣概的嗓音。)
Traditional ideas about masculine roles are changing in modern society.
(現代社會中，關於男性角色的傳統觀念正在改變。)

massage(n./v.)按摩
masseur(n.)按摩師
foot massage 腳底按摩
give sb. a massage 幫某人按摩
After a long day of hiking, a foot massage feels wonderful.
(健行一整天之後，做個腳底按摩感覺真棒。)
She massaged her father's shoulders to help him relax.
(她幫爸爸按摩肩膀讓他放鬆。)

massive(adj.)巨大的、大量的
mass(n.)大量、團塊
massively(adv.)大規模地
massive amount 大量
massive earthquake 大地震
A massive earthquake struck the area early this morning.
(今天清晨一場大地震襲擊了該地區。)
The company spent a massive amount of money on advertising.
(這家公司花了大筆金錢在廣告上。)

masterpiece(n.)傑作、名作
(無詞性變化)
literary masterpiece 文學名著
true masterpiece 真正的傑作
The Mona Lisa is considered Leonardo da Vinci's masterpiece.
(《蒙娜麗莎》被視為達文西的傑作。)
Many critics call this film a masterpiece of modern cinema.
(許多影評人稱這部電影為現代電影的傑作。)

mattress(n.)床墊
(無詞性變化)
firm mattress 硬床墊
air mattress 充氣床墊
A good mattress can improve the quality of your sleep.
(好的床墊能改善你的睡眠品質。)
We slept on air mattresses during the camping trip.
(露營期間我們睡在充氣床墊上。)

meantime(n./adv.)其間、同時
meanwhile(adv.)同時
in the meantime 在此期間
for the meantime 暫時
The doctor will see you soon; in the meantime, please fill out this form.
(醫生很快就會看診；在此期間，請填寫這張表格。)
Dinner won't be ready for an hour, so have some fruit in the meantime.
(晚餐還要一個小時才好，你先吃點水果吧。)

mechanism(n.)機制、機械裝置
mechanical(adj.)機械的
mechanic(n.)技工
defense mechanism 防衛機制
safety mechanism 安全裝置
Sweating is the body's natural mechanism for cooling down.
(流汗是身體自然的降溫機制。)
The safety mechanism stops the machine if something goes wrong.
(一旦出問題，安全裝置會讓機器停止運轉。)

medication(n.)藥物、藥物治療
medicate(v.)用藥治療
medical(adj.)醫學的
take medication 服藥
on medication 正在服藥
Remember to take your medication after meals.
(記得飯後服藥。)
Some medications can make you feel sleepy.
(有些藥物會讓你昏昏欲睡。)

mentor(n.)導師、指導者
mentorship(n.)指導關係
act as a mentor 擔任導師
mentor program 導師制度
My coach has been a great mentor to me over the years.
(這些年來我的教練一直是我很好的導師。)
The school pairs each new teacher with an experienced mentor.
(學校為每位新老師安排一位資深的指導者。)

merge(v.)合併、融合
merger(n.)(公司)合併
merge with 與……合併
merge into 融入
The two small companies merged to form a larger one.
(這兩家小公司合併成一家較大的公司。)
Drivers must slow down where the two lanes merge.
(在兩線道匯合處，駕駛必須減速。)

metaphor(n.)隱喻、暗喻
metaphorical(adj.)隱喻的
use a metaphor 使用隱喻
metaphor for 象徵……的隱喻
In the poem, the journey is a metaphor for life.
(在這首詩中，旅程是人生的隱喻。)
Writers often use metaphors to make their ideas more vivid.
(作家常使用隱喻讓想法更生動。)

metropolitan(adj./n.)大都市的、都會區居民
metropolis(n.)大都市
metropolitan area 都會區
metropolitan museum 大都會博物館
More than seven million people live in the Taipei metropolitan area.
(超過七百萬人住在台北都會區。)
Housing prices in metropolitan areas keep rising.
(都會區的房價持續上漲。)

midst(n./prep.)中間、當中
(無詞性變化)
in the midst of 在……之中
in our midst 在我們之中
In the midst of the crisis, the mayor stayed calm.
(在危機當中，市長保持冷靜。)
She found a quiet café in the midst of the busy city.
(她在繁忙的城市中找到一間安靜的咖啡廳。)

migration(n.)遷徙、移居
migrate(v.)遷徙
migrant(n.)移民、候鳥
bird migration 鳥類遷徙
mass migration 大規模移居
Every winter, birdwatchers gather to watch the migration of black-faced spoonbills.
(每年冬天，賞鳥人士聚集觀賞黑面琵鷺的遷徙。)
Rural-to-urban migration has changed the population structure.
(城鄉移居改變了人口結構。)

milestone(n.)里程碑、重要事件
(無詞性變化)
major milestone 重大里程碑
reach a milestone 達到里程碑
Graduating from high school is an important milestone in life.
(高中畢業是人生中重要的里程碑。)
The invention of the internet was a milestone in human history.
(網際網路的發明是人類歷史上的里程碑。)

miniature(adj./n.)小型的、縮圖、模型
mini(adj.)迷你的
in miniature 縮小的
miniature model 微縮模型
He built a miniature model of the Taipei 101 building.
(他製作了一個台北101的微縮模型。)
The theme park shows famous buildings in miniature.
(這座主題樂園以縮小的形式展示著名建築。)

minimal(adj.)最小的、極少的
minimum(n./adj.)最小量、最低的
minimize(v.)減到最少
minimal cost 極低的成本
minimal effort 最少的力氣
The storm caused only minimal damage to the town.
(暴風雨對小鎮只造成極少的損害。)
She prefers a minimal style with simple furniture.
(她偏好家具簡單的極簡風格。)

minimize(v.)使減到最少、輕描淡寫
minimum(n.)最小量
minimal(adj.)最小的
minimize the risk 將風險降到最低
minimize waste 減少浪費
Wearing a helmet can minimize the risk of head injuries.
(戴安全帽能將頭部受傷的風險降到最低。)
We should minimize the use of plastic bags.
(我們應盡量減少使用塑膠袋。)

mint(n.)薄荷、鑄幣廠、大筆錢
minty(adj.)薄荷味的
mint tea 薄荷茶
in mint condition 嶄新的
She added some fresh mint leaves to the lemonade.
(她在檸檬水裡加了一些新鮮薄荷葉。)
The old comic book is still in mint condition.
(這本舊漫畫仍然完好如新。)

missionary(n./adj.)傳教士、傳教的
mission(n.)任務、使命
missionary school 教會學校
missionary work 傳教工作
George Mackay was a missionary who founded schools and clinics in Tamsui.
(馬偕是一位在淡水創辦學校和診所的傳教士。)
Many early hospitals in Taiwan were set up by missionaries.
(台灣許多早期的醫院是由傳教士建立的。)

moan(n./v.)呻吟、抱怨
(無詞性變化)
moan about 抱怨
moan in pain 痛苦地呻吟
The injured player lay on the ground, moaning in pain.
(受傷的球員躺在地上痛苦地呻吟。)
Stop moaning about the homework and just do it.
(別再抱怨作業了，去寫就對了。)

mock(adj./v./n.)模擬的、嘲笑、模仿
mockery(n.)嘲弄
mock exam 模擬考
mock sb. for 因……嘲笑某人
We will have a mock exam before the real one.
(正式考試前我們會先有一次模擬考。)
It's unkind to mock others for their accents.
(嘲笑別人的口音是很不厚道的。)

mode(n.)方式、模式
(無詞性變化)
mode of transportation 交通方式
airplane mode 飛航模式
Please switch your phone to airplane mode before takeoff.
(起飛前請將手機切換成飛航模式。)
The bicycle is an eco-friendly mode of transportation.
(腳踏車是環保的交通方式。)

modify(v.)修改、調整、修飾
modification(n.)修改
modify a plan 修改計畫
genetically modified 基因改造的
We need to modify our plan because of the bad weather.
(由於天氣不佳，我們需要修改計畫。)
Some people avoid eating genetically modified food.
(有些人避免食用基因改造食品。)

molecule(n.)分子
molecular(adj.)分子的
water molecule 水分子
molecule of oxygen 氧分子
A water molecule is made up of two hydrogen atoms and one oxygen atom.
(一個水分子由兩個氫原子和一個氧原子組成。)
Heat makes molecules move faster.
(熱會讓分子移動得更快。)

monopoly(n.)壟斷、獨占
monopolize(v.)壟斷
have a monopoly on 壟斷……
state monopoly 國家專賣
The company had a monopoly on the market for years.
(這家公司多年來壟斷這個市場。)
Nobody has a monopoly on good ideas.
(好點子並不是某個人的專利。)

morality(n.)道德、道德觀
moral(adj./n.)道德的、寓意
immorality(n.)不道德
public morality 公共道德
sense of morality 道德感
The novel raises important questions about morality.
(這本小說提出了關於道德的重要問題。)
Parents play a key role in teaching children morality.
(父母在教導孩子道德方面扮演關鍵角色。)

mortality(n.)死亡率、必死性
mortal(adj.)必死的、致命的
immortality(n.)不朽
infant mortality 嬰兒死亡率
mortality rate 死亡率
Better health care has greatly reduced infant mortality.
(更好的醫療照護大幅降低了嬰兒死亡率。)
The mortality rate of the disease is very low.
(這種疾病的死亡率非常低。)

mortgage(n.)抵押貸款、房貸
(無詞性變化)
pay off a mortgage 還清房貸
take out a mortgage 申辦房貸
My parents took out a mortgage to buy our house.
(我父母申辦了房貸來買我們的房子。)
It will take them twenty years to pay off the mortgage.
(他們要花二十年才能還清房貸。)

motive(n.)動機、目的
motivate(v.)激勵
motivation(n.)動機
hidden motive 隱藏的動機
motive for 做……的動機
The police are still trying to find the motive for the crime.
(警方仍在試圖找出犯案動機。)
I wonder what his real motive for helping us was.
(我很好奇他幫我們的真正動機是什麼。)

mount(n./v.)山、登上、騎上、增加、安裝
mountain(n.)山
Mount Jade 玉山
mount a horse 騎上馬
Mount Jade is the highest mountain in Taiwan.
(玉山是台灣最高的山。)
Pressure on students mounts as the exam gets closer.
(隨著考試逼近，學生的壓力逐漸增加。)

mumble(v./n.)喃喃自語、含糊地說
(無詞性變化)
mumble an apology 含糊地道歉
mumble to oneself 自言自語
He mumbled an apology and left the room.
(他含糊地道了歉就離開了房間。)
Please speak clearly; don't mumble when you give a speech.
(演講時請說清楚，不要含糊不清。)

municipal(adj.)市政的、市立的
municipality(n.)直轄市、自治市
municipal government 市政府
municipal library 市立圖書館
Songshan Senior High School is a municipal school in Taipei.
(松山高中是台北市的市立學校。)
The municipal government plans to build more bike lanes.
(市政府計畫興建更多自行車道。)

muscular(adj.)肌肉的、肌肉發達的
muscle(n.)肌肉
muscular body 健壯的身體
muscular strength 肌力
After months of training, he became strong and muscular.
(經過幾個月的訓練，他變得強壯又肌肉發達。)
Regular exercise helps improve muscular strength.
(規律運動有助於提升肌力。)

mustard(n.)芥末、芥菜
(無詞性變化)
mustard sauce 芥末醬
mustard greens 芥菜
He likes to put mustard on his hot dog.
(他喜歡在熱狗上加芥末醬。)
Mustard greens are a common vegetable in Taiwanese cooking.
(芥菜是台灣料理中常見的蔬菜。)

myth(n.)神話、迷思
mythical(adj.)神話的、虛構的
mythology(n.)神話學
Greek myth 希臘神話
common myth 常見迷思
It is a common myth that we only use ten percent of our brains.
(認為人類只用了大腦百分之十是常見的迷思。)
The story of Hou Yi shooting the suns is an ancient Chinese myth.
(后羿射日是一則中國古代神話。)

naive(adj.)天真的、幼稚的
naivety(n.)天真
naively(adv.)天真地
naive belief 天真的想法
politically naive 政治上天真的
It was naive of me to believe everything I read online.
(我相信網路上讀到的所有東西，真是太天真了。)
She asked a naive question, but the teacher answered it kindly.
(她問了一個天真的問題，但老師親切地回答了。)

narrative(n./adj.)敘述、故事、敘事的
narrate(v.)敘述
narrator(n.)敘述者
narrative writing 記敘文
personal narrative 個人經歷敘述
The novel's narrative jumps between the past and the present.
(這部小說的敘事在過去與現在之間跳躍。)
We were asked to write a narrative essay about a memorable trip.
(我們被要求寫一篇關於難忘旅行的記敘文。)

nasty(adj.)令人不快的、惡劣的、嚴重的
nastiness(n.)惡劣
nasty smell 難聞的氣味
nasty cold 重感冒
There's a nasty smell coming from the trash can.
(垃圾桶散發出一股難聞的氣味。)
She was nasty to her classmates, so no one wanted to sit with her.
(她對同學很惡劣，所以沒人想跟她坐。)

negotiation(n.)談判、協商
negotiate(v.)談判
negotiator(n.)談判者
under negotiation 協商中
peace negotiations 和平談判
After weeks of negotiation, the two sides signed an agreement.
(經過數週的談判，雙方簽署了協議。)
The price of the house is still under negotiation.
(房子的價格仍在協商中。)

neutral(adj./n.)中立的、中性的、中立者
neutrality(n.)中立
neutralize(v.)使中和
remain neutral 保持中立
neutral color 中性色
Switzerland remained neutral during World War II.
(瑞士在第二次世界大戰期間保持中立。)
Gray and beige are neutral colors that match everything.
(灰色和米色是百搭的中性色。)

nominate(v.)提名、任命
nomination(n.)提名
nominee(n.)被提名人
nominate sb. for 提名某人角逐……
be nominated as 被提名為
The film was nominated for five Golden Horse Awards.
(這部電影獲得五項金馬獎提名。)
Our class nominated Amy as the student council representative.
(我們班提名艾咪擔任學生會代表。)

nomination(n.)提名、任命
nominate(v.)提名
receive a nomination 獲得提名
Oscar nomination 奧斯卡提名
The actress received her first Oscar nomination this year.
(這位女演員今年首度獲得奧斯卡提名。)
The party announced his nomination for mayor.
(該黨宣布提名他角逐市長。)

nominee(n.)被提名人
nominate(v.)提名
nomination(n.)提名
award nominee 入圍者
presidential nominee 總統候選人
All the nominees for Best Actor were invited to the ceremony.
(所有最佳男主角入圍者都受邀出席典禮。)
The nominee gave a speech after being chosen by the party.
(被提名人在獲得黨內提名後發表演說。)

nonprofit(adj.)非營利的
profit(n.)利潤
nonprofit organization 非營利組織
nonprofit group 非營利團體
She volunteers at a nonprofit organization that helps stray animals.
(她在一個幫助流浪動物的非營利組織當志工。)
The museum is run by a nonprofit foundation.
(這間博物館由一個非營利基金會經營。)

norm(n.)規範、標準、常態
normal(adj.)正常的
social norm 社會規範
the norm 常態
Working from home has become the norm for many people.
(在家工作已經成為許多人的常態。)
Different cultures have different social norms.
(不同文化有不同的社會規範。)

noticeable(adj.)顯著的、明顯的
notice(v./n.)注意、通知
noticeably(adv.)顯著地
noticeable difference 明顯的差異
noticeable improvement 顯著的進步
There has been a noticeable improvement in her English.
(她的英文有明顯的進步。)
The scar on his arm is barely noticeable now.
(他手臂上的疤痕現在幾乎看不出來了。)

notify(v.)通知、告知
notification(n.)通知
notify sb. of 通知某人……
be notified 收到通知
Please notify the teacher if you are going to be absent.
(如果你要請假，請通知老師。)
Students will be notified of their exam results by email.
(學生將透過電子郵件收到考試成績通知。)

notion(n.)概念、想法、觀念
notional(adj.)概念上的
the notion that ……的觀念
vague notion 模糊的概念
The notion that money brings happiness is not always true.
(金錢帶來幸福的觀念不見得都正確。)
I had no notion of how difficult the job would be.
(我完全不知道這份工作會這麼困難。)

nowhere(adv./pron.)無處、任何地方都不
(無詞性變化)
nowhere near 遠遠不及
out of nowhere 突然冒出來
A dog came running out of nowhere and scared me.
(一隻狗突然衝出來嚇了我一跳。)
My essay is nowhere near finished.
(我的作文還差得遠才寫完。)
